banner.bannedBody: You can still sign in and view your data; payments and changes are turned off. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.
banner.suspended: Payments are paused on this account while we look into an issue. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
banner.warnings_one: Your account has an active warning; see your alerts for why. {{left}} more within the warning period will make the account read-only. Questions? Contact support.
banner.warnings_other: Your account has {{count}} active warnings; see your alerts for why. {{left}} more within the warning period will make the account read-only. Questions? Contact support.
banner.onFreePlan: Your account is on the free plan until it goes through.

restricted.readOnly: Your account is read-only until {{date}}, so this is turned off. You can still sign in and view your data.
restricted.paymentsPaused: Payments are paused on this account while we look into an issue, so this is turned off. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
